body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose yourself or one ally within 4 units. The target gains +1 Defense until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: Increase the Defense bonus from this Action by 1.
Reduce forced movement against the target by 1 unit until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: BARRIER — STRAIN
rider.html: If you gained Strain while resolving this Action, the first time the target is attacked before your next turn it gains an additional +1 Defense.
